name: shunt-anywhere
description: Token-saving delegation plugin that works on Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and DeepSeek Harness.

plugins.name: shunt
plugins.description: Saves tokens by shunting I/O-heavy work to a cheap worker model. Hooks block large file reads and redirect to bulk-read/code-write, which run one headless turn on whichever CLI you have: claude, gemini or codex.
